Name: (CP) Wind Turbines
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]
﻿
Ever thought: there's these huge bulky wind turbines all over the place sticking out of the ground like a [s]sore thumb[/s] beanstalk? Ever wondered why you don't have one of these magnificent wonders in your own backyard? Well, stop thinking because we present you: [i]the Stalk™.

[/i]You have all these pesky boring lightning rods that are so tiny and totally not cool laying around and don't know what to do with them? Great! Now you can go to your local Carpenter and turn them in for a neat cool and totally better wind turbine that will put all eyes onto you!

So, what are you waiting for? Get your radical wind turbine today!!!!

Has a 50/50 Chance of giving you a battery daily :D

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI, MMAP and Content Patcher.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.
